messages:
Aisha (CS): quick heads-up — we need an outbound to customers impacted by today’s inference slowdowns in eu-west-1. seen elevated tail latency and intermittent 5xx for embedding endpoints starting 2026-03-19 14:12 UTC. partial mitigation applied (fallback routing + autoscale), but some accounts still seeing degraded throughput. drafting comms + credits proposal. who can own follow-ups for top accounts?
Marta R (AE): I can own top 20 accounts (enterprise tier). send draft, I'll personalize. will also flag renewals that might be at risk. :+1:
Tom S (Solutions): adding a quick tech blurb we can paste into notes. root cause still under investigation but likely GC spike on q8 quantized kernels + scheduling edge-case on the dedicated pools. mitigation steps we pushed: 1) routing fallback to compatible variants, 2) increased pod headroom for the affected pool, 3) disabled a recent kernel experiment. health checks show progress but not fully stable.
Luis (Support): I'll open support tickets for each affected account and attach the draft comms. can we include a recommended temporary config for customers on dedicated capacity? saves back-and-forth.
DeployBot: Incident IN-2026-1855 created by SRE Oncall — status: investigating. Pager triggered at 2026-03-19T14:14:07Z.
SRE Oncall: confirming Tom's note — GC scheduling + kernel combo caused sporadic stalls on long-seq paths. mitigation plan: revert kernel tweak (done), bump sched buffer to 30% (in-progress), enable KV cache sticky routing (planned).
Aisha (CS): draft outbound below. please review, comment quickly — we need to send a first status update within 30m. also propose 10% service credit for affected windows; thoughts?
Aisha (CS): ```
Subject: Status update — Temporary degradation in eu-west-1 (affecting inference latency)

Hi there,

We want to let you know about a temporary degradation that affected inference latency and throughput in eu-west-1 starting on 19 Mar 2026 at ~14:12 UTC. Our engineers detected elevated tail latency and intermittent errors for embedding and long-context generation requests.

What we did:
- Automatically routed traffic to compatible model variants to reduce errors.
- Increased pool capacity and rolled back an experimental kernel change.
- Continued monitoring with heightened alerts.

What you may see:
- Slower responses or occasional 5xx for in-flight requests during the incident window.

Next steps:
- We are working on a full fix and expect stability improvements in the next few hours.
- We will follow up with an RCA within 72 hours and a summary of any credits applied.

If you'd like us to schedule a 15-min sync to review impact on your workloads, reply to this message and we'll set it up.

Apologies for the disruption — we know this impacts your product and appreciate the patience.

Thanks,
Aisha and the Redwood CS Team
```
Tom S (Solutions): small edits: add "affected endpoints: embeddings, long-context generation" and suggest adding a link to the status page + incident ID. also add a safe-recommendation block customers can apply if they control dedicated pool config: 
```
Recommended temporary config (dedicated):
- reduce max_seq_len to 2048 for heavy tails
- enable kv_cache_sticky = true
- set batch_timeout_ms = 8
```
Marta R (AE): looks good. approve the 10% credit for impacted 30-min windows; for a few top accounts we can offer a waived overage for the month as a gesture if they're flagged as renewal risks. I'll compile the renewal-risk list and DM Aisha.
Luis (Support): creating tickets now and will attach the outbound draft + per-account logs. I'll tag ticket with INC-1855 and link back to this thread.
Aisha (CS): action items below — put owners and ETA.
- Finalize outbound text (Aisha) — 10m
- Personalize notes for top 20 (Marta) — 30m
- Open support tickets + attach logs (Luis) — 15m
- Send first status update to affected accounts (Aisha) — 30m
- Prepare RCA skeleton (Tom) — 72h
- Compile renewal-risk list and propose commercial gestures (Marta) — 2 business days

Aisha (CS): also: escalate list for any account that replies "critical production" — @marta & @luis please prioritize immediate callbacks.
Marta R (AE): acknowledged. will set calendar blocks for callbacks.
SRE Oncall: we'll post a technical update to the status page once we confirm full stability; will attach timeline and root-cause summary for RCA.
Aisha (CS): thanks all. I'll post the outbound in 15 minutes and update this thread after send. :handshake:
